statement.excerpt: Promises for world-changing science that rarely materialize.
statement.document_title: GPT-5: Overdue, overhyped and underwhelming. And that’s not the worst of it.

our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that only a small proportion of promises of transformative AI-assisted scientific advances had delivered the promised results by the post date.
The surrounding text describes several preceding years without specifying their beginning. The target period therefore has an unspecified start and ends on the post date.
Individual successes or failures cannot establish how frequently promises materialized. Promises whose stated deadlines had not arrived must not be counted as failures.
criteria.support_condition: A reasonably representative inventory of scientific promises and independently validated outcomes shows that fulfillment was infrequent by the post date, accounting for the promises' deadlines.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A reasonably representative inventory shows that fulfillment was common by the post date.
